dct_creator_sm: Eng, Rachel (Department of Psychology. College of Social and Applied Human Sciences. University of Guelph.). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1931-5611
dct_description_sm: The purpose of this project was to investigate the effect of item heterogeneity and target similarity on Multiple Object Tracking accuracy. Items were 16 unique combinations of four colours and four shapes. To manipulate target similarity, the four targets could have the same colour/shape or no common features.
dct_title_s: Data for: Multiple-object tracking in displays where each item is unique: Do competing organizations impair the ability to track targets that share a common colour or shape?
